newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee slips on import covering.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee slips on import covering.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed a shade lower against the dollar due to commercial demand for the U.S. unit, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.10, after opening at 57.06 and holding that level due to a lack of demand for dollars in early trade, they said.
"The dollar moved in a tight range, between 57.09 and the Central Bank top level of 57.10 due to import covering," said a Standard Chartered dealer.
Overnight call money closed at 14.5 percent after opening at 15, due to many big lenders entering the market, he said.
